title: Passive Voice
objectives: Form the present passive for all conjugations
Form the perfect passive using participle + esse

grammar.explanation: In the passive voice, the subject receives the action. Present tense passives add -r to active endings. Perfect passives use the perfect passive participle + sum. Deponent verbs are passive in form but active in meaning.
rules: Perfect passive participle agrees with subject in gender/number
Deponents: passive form, active meaning, active principal parts

exercises.question: Translate: Urbs a militibus capta est.
exercises.answer: The city was captured by the soldiers.

readingPassage.latin: Roma a Romulo condita est. Multi hostes a Romanis victi sunt. Captivi in urbem ducti sunt. Senatus convocatus est et de victoria locutus est.
readingPassage.translation: Rome was founded by Romulus. Many enemies were conquered by the Romans. Captives were led into the city. The senate was convened and spoke about the victory.
notes: locutus est: perfect of deponent loquor
